About us

Seatlr: a social network built for travelers

Seatlr is a social platform dedicated to travelers worldwide, bringing them together in one city room regardless of airline or booking date. We believe the best recommendations for hotels, restaurants and attractions come from real travelers living the experience with you moment by moment — that's why we built an AI assistant and alerts, refreshed throughout the day, that accompany you from the moment you book until you're back home.

Read our full story

❓ Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)

Everything you need to know about Seatlr

Didn't find your answer? Our team is ready to help through the contact page.

What is this app about?+

Seatlr is a social network for travelers that automatically connects you to a chat room with everyone heading to your city, plus an AI assistant that recommends hotels, restaurants and attractions, and alerts on flights, security and weather updated several times a day.

Is the translation feature free?+

Yes. Translation and the smart assistant are completely free at no extra cost, and your data is protected to the highest privacy standards.

How do I join a city room?+

Enter your flight number when you open the app, and you'll be automatically connected to your destination's chat room with all other travelers heading to the same city.

Can I delete my account?+

Yes, you can delete your account at any time from the app settings, and your data will be permanently erased with no copies retained.

I forgot my password. What do I do?+

Choose "Forgot password" on the sign-in screen, and you'll receive a reset message within minutes.

How does the smart assistant work?+

The smart assistant answers your questions about laws, customs, hotels and restaurants instantly and in your language, with your data handled securely to the highest privacy standards.

How can I contact support or learn more about the team?+

You can reach us at support@seatlr.com or through the contact form below. To learn more about our team and mission, visit the "About us" section.

Is my data safe?+

We follow a privacy-first policy: we use nicknames, and messages are automatically deleted within 24 hours with no backups.

How much does it cost?+

Downloading the app and using its core features — city rooms, the smart assistant, and alerts — is currently completely free.

Contact us

Have a question? We'd love to hear it

Send us your message and our team will get back to you as soon as possible.
